metadata.description: OnlyCopilotFans plugins for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central AL development.

plugins.name: ocpf-bc
plugins.description: The OnlyCopilotFans Business Central Agentic Development Framework: a guided DEFINE, DESIGN, BUILD, PROVE routine for building AL extensions the right way, per-tenant or for AppSource. Three journeys, one standard: Build-a-Feature for quick customizations in minutes (no steps, six short documents written as the work happens, not vibe-coding), Full for a complete app or solution end to end (three models, the full document and testing trail; the recommended journey), and Lite for updating an existing app or a new app without a large footprint (one model, fewer steps, leaner documents). Analyzes and documents an undocumented existing app before extending it, sets up the latest runbook, connects Microsoft's AL tools with nothing to install, adds reasoning, light, generator, and reviewer sub-agents (batches generated in parallel; a pre-review before the first package), writes every project document from a template, builds Business Central Copilot features from the verified OnlyBCFans BC Copilot Blueprint in any journey, draws an app icon when you have none, builds a polished HTML help site from the documents (user guide, documentation, FAQ, screenshots, GitHub Pages), estimates human and AI effort, measures token usage and cost at every step boundary with the published prices fetched by the script itself, and keeps a live HTML dashboard of the build.
